subject: Covary observed variable with latent variable

messages.author: e204e9a8d0f3a7f8
messages.subject: Covary observed variable with latent variable
parts:
Say I have the following:

LV.model <- '

              F1 =~ x1 + x2 + x3 
              F2 =~ x4 + x5 + x6
             
            '
and I also have a single observed variable y1, so the dataset has the variable x1-x6 and y1.

How do I specify a covariance between y1 and F1 and F2 in a CFA? I've tried the following but it is not working.

LV.model <- '

              F1 =~ x1 + x2 + x3 
              F2 =~ x4 + x5 + x6
              
             F1 ~~ y1
             F2 ~~ y1
            '


Any thoughts?

Thanks,

Scott

messages.author: 99a06696c483481a
messages.subject: Re: Covary observed variable with latent variable
parts:
Create a factor equal to the observed

Y1 ~ 1*y1
y1 ~~ 0*y1

Then let that covary with the other factors

F1 + F2 ~~ Y1

parts:
Thanks for your response, Edward.  However, your approach didn't work with my simulated data.  I'm pasting a reproducible example below along with the error message.


cov.model <- structure(c(1, 0.49, 0.49, 0.49, 0.28, 0.49, 1, 0.49, 0.49, 0.28, 
0.49, 0.49, 1, 0.49, 0.28, 0.49, 0.49, 0.49, 1, 0.28, 0.28, 0.28, 
0.28, 0.28, 1), .Dim = c(5L, 5L), .Dimnames = list(c("y1", "y2", 
"y3", "y4", "x1"), c("y1", "y2", "y3", "y4", "x1")))

mu <- rep(0, 5)
sd <- rep(1, 5)

library(MASS)
d2 <- as.data.frame(mvrnorm(n = 1000, mu = mu, Sigma = cov.model, empirical = TRUE))


popln.model <- '

   f1 =~ y1 + y2 + y3 + y4

   x1_p ~ 1*x1
   x1 ~~ 0*x1
   
   f1 ~~ x1_p
   
   '


popln.df.fit <- cfa(popln.model, # choice of model
                    data = d2,
                    estimator = "ML", # choice of estimator, see http://lavaan.ugent.be/tutorial/est.html
                    std.lv = TRUE) # standardizes all factors (means = 0, SDs = 1), overrides default to fix first indicator loading on all factors to 1

Error in lavaan::lavaan(model = popln.model, data = d2, estimator = "ML",  :

messages.subject: Re: Covary observed variable with latent variable
parts:
Typo in my email. Change:
     x1_p ~ 1*x1 
to:
     x1_p =~ 1*x1 
--Ed Rigdon

The =~ operator says that the LHS is a latent variable.
